import sys

def solve():

    ptr = 0
    T = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input[ptr])
        ptr += 1
        P = list(map(int, input[ptr:ptr+N]))
        ptr += N
        pos = [0]*(N+1)
        for idx, val in enumerate(P):
            pos[val] = idx+1
        target = list(range(1, N+1))
        cost = 0
        operations = []
        current = P.copy()
        for i in range(N):
            if current[i] != target[i]:
                j = pos[target[i]] - 1
                cost += abs(i - j)
                current[i], current[j] = current[j], current[i]
                operations.append((i+1, j+1))
